Definition: from the base of G3145; a (properly, female) breast (as if kneaded up):--pap.
BiblicalUsage: The word is the breast, named in the most human moments of the Gospels. A woman in the crowd blesses the breasts that nursed Jesus, and Jesus Himself says the barren will be called blessed in the days of judgment. In Revelation the risen Christ is seen girded across His chest with a golden girdle, the breast named as the place of His strength and honour.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the word reminds us that Christ took a real human body, nursed as a child and pierced as a man, and that the risen Lord still wears that body in glory.
